honor: Grand Cross of the Order of Merit of the Republic of Poland (Krzyż Wielki Orderu Zasługi Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej)
awarded_by: President of the Republic of Poland, Andrzej Duda
detail: Awarded to him as foreign minister by a decision of 4 October 2021 'for outstanding merit in developing Polish-Cypriot cooperation', published in the Polish official gazette Monitor Polski (2022, item 97).
